items.known: CKV_AWS_382 Ensure no security groups allow egress from 0.0.0.0:0 to port -1 (resource aws_security_group.loadtest)
items.remediation: Restrict the egress block to only the specific ports, protocols, and CIDR ranges required by the application. Remove or replace the egress rule with targeted rules, e.g. limit to port 443 for known endpoints instead of cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"] with protocol "-1".

scores.reason: Correctly identifies the aws_security_group egress rule and recommends replacing protocol "-1" with specific ports/protocols and restricting cidr_blocks from 0.0.0.0/0 to required destinations.
